justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: UPDRS-III motor improvements consistent; gait speed and stride length gains documented. Long-term maintenance variable.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: 2-day training course; ~$500+ fee; biennial recertification required.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: High value for PTs treating Parkinson disease; limited applicability outside neuro-specific settings.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Billed under PT codes; Medicare and commercial cover as standard PT; LSVT documentation supports Parkinson disease medical necessity.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Among the most employer-demanded PT certifications for neuro outpatient; frequently paired with LSVT LOUD.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Parkinson's patients value functional independence improvements; family engagement is high.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Parkinson's patients and families will pay for intensive programs; partial cash-pay viability.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: Protocol-based package pricing supports modest premium in neuro niche.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Trademark-protected with limited certified providers; defensible.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Protocolized; multiple certified staff can deliver consistently.
justifications.business.marketDemand: PD community actively searches for LSVT-certified providers.
justifications.business.efficiency: Multi-day certification with recertification fees; moderate cost.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Useful neuro credential but commercial; secondary to NCS for promotion.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: Solid publication base around LSVT BIG/LOUD efficacy.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Anchors PD case content in neuro curricula nicely.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Several trials support efficacy; some methodological critiques remain.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Occasionally preferred for neuro faculty with PD focus.
justifications.academicClinical.efficiency: Moderate cost/time; not the cheapest neuro credential to add.
